title: My son said no
text: My son said no. By the third night we had to take it off, since it was waking my son up all night long. It was just too loud and crunchy sounding (even with -two- white nose apps running in the back ground). He is such a light sleeper though, so solid sleeps my not care one bit. On a positive note, it was easy to get on and off. And stayed in place while we tried it out.
